darpan.migration.DarpanMigration.description: Fold every automation's run history into its stored clean-day streak, so the clean-run Chat line reads the day count from the first message (DAR-BE-144). Idempotent — a fold reads only slots past the stored cursor.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Payment transaction ids
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-153: comma-joined OPP manualRefNums (the Shopify transaction id each OPP names), read from up to six OPPs; null when all six slots came back full, so a longer list is never claimed short. Compared against Shopify paymentTransactionIds (paymentTransactionIds all in paymentRefNums).

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Payment transaction ids
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-153: comma-joined ids of the SUCCESS SALE and CAPTURE transactions, and of a SUCCESS AUTHORIZATION nothing captured; the ids HotWax keeps on its OPPs as manualRefNum.
